description: Defines interfaces, classes, and data structures for input processing and motion classification in Android's input flinger service, including event types, classifiers, and input processor implementation.

classes.name: ClassifierEventType
classes.description: Enumeration of different input event types such as MOTION, DEVICE_RESET, HAL_RESET, and EXIT.

classes.name: ClassifierEvent
classes.description: Represents an input classifier event with type and optional arguments, including factory methods for HAL reset and exit events.

classes.name: MotionClassifierInterface
classes.description: Interface for motion classifiers that classify motion events, reset internal state, dump state, and monitor health.

classes.name: InputProcessorInterface
classes.description: Base interface for input processing stages, providing methods to enable classifiers, dump state, and monitor.

classes.name: ScopedDeathRecipient
classes.description: Manages death notification for binder objects, linking to death and handling cleanup.

classes.name: MotionClassifier
classes.description: Implementation of MotionClassifierInterface that communicates with the InputProcessor HAL to classify motion events asynchronously.

classes.name: InputProcessor
classes.description: Implements InputProcessorInterface, acts as a processing stage for input events, forwarding non-motion events and classifying motion events.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a MotionClassifier instance with a given InputProcessor HAL service.

methods.name: classify
methods.description: Classifies a motion event asynchronously, possibly delayed by a few events.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the classifier.

methods.name: reset (with args)
methods.description: Resets the classifier state for a specific device.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the internal state for debugging.

methods.name: monitor
methods.description: Checks the health/status of the classifier.
